ctx.x: Huh. How was it in those times, again '20's and '30's especially, in working with unions? I know you've mentioned a couple of times various things that have happened, but in general did you feel as much pressure from union or did you feel that the union was very useful or just how was it or did you just basically, ignore it?

Tom, I think in those days, in the early days, the union officials were more strict than they are now. I really do. I'm judging from the international -- of course, they've changed a lot, "and" and their personnel, of course.
